title: SigChainworks composition studio
description: Signature Chainworks is a Signature original: an LLM application framework where every component (prompts, models, tools, memories, retrievers) is a SigRunnable composed with pipes, streaming and async throughout. Its runnable protocol, composition operators, and agent runtime are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('flow = prompt | model | parser  # SigRunnable pipes')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
flow = prompt | model | parser  # SigRunnable pipes
edition: Signature original
